title: Second identification on an already-claimed trip
description: A second identDrv arrives 130 seconds after the first, while the trip is still open. The claim is already decided by the first identification (an advisory lock plus a partial unique index on the trip), so the second is expected to persist audit-only: recorded, linked to the trip, but never the assignee source. Must prove: the asset assignee and the trip assignee both stay on the first driver (A). Must NOT change: neither assignee may move to the second driver (B), and there must never be two rows both carrying is_assignee_source.

driver_identifications.note: second identification, same trip; the claim is already decided and this must not move either assignee
